coverageNotes: SCOPE. Gap-fill for the 20 critic-named companies. None was already in the raw dataset under another name (checked by name/alias regex over every E*/G*/X05 file; Vijaya Bank's MG Road head office had been deliberately dropped by G13, and Indegene was only mentioned in G09's notes as belonging to another lens). All 20 are recorded. METHOD. The shared web-search budget was already exhausted when this task started, so no web searches were run; evidence comes from direct fetches of official pages (Indegene, Rajesh Exports, KAPL, BRBNMPL, POWERGRID, KEONICS, BMRCL, Aster, Sparsh, Narayana Nethralaya, Cloudnine), Wikipedia, and OpenStreetMap objects (osm_lookup + Nominatim/Photon geocoder). Coordinates are OSM building/POI positions where mapped; street centroids or area centroids where only a street/area is known (said so in geocodeSource and evidence). CORRECTIONS TO THE BRIEF. KEONICS's head office is #59 Railway Parallel Road, Kumara Park West, Seshadripuram (its own site), not Shanthinagar. KAPL's registered/corporate office and factory are in Peenya Industrial Area 2nd Phase (its own site), not Rajajinagar/Yeshwanthpur. Narayana Nethralaya began in 1982 (Wikipedia), not 1993. CATEGORY CALLS. Apollo Hospitals (62,939 employees, listed) and Fortis (~23,000, listed) are MNC under the Indian+listed+>10,000 rule; Fortis's origin is Foreign because Malaysia's IHH Healthcare holds the 31.1% controlling stake. Aster DM Healthcare stays MID_SIZE because its post-April-2024 India-only headcount could not be found (the 32,400 figure is from 2022 and includes the divested GCC business). DTDC (13,000 employees, unlisted) and Rajesh Exports (160 permanent workers, listed) sit outside the MID_SIZE headcount band but fit no other category. WEAK SPOTS. EdgeVerve is LOW confidence: edgeverve.com and finacle.com refuse automated fetches, so its placement on the Infosys Electronics City campus rests on the brief plus Wikipedia's statement that Finacle has belonged to EdgeVerve since 2015. Bank of Baroda's office is the International Banking Branch in the former Vijaya Bank head office (41/2 MG Road) per a Wikipedia caption; the building is not in OSM, so the point is the Trinity Circle junction (approximate); BoB's Bengaluru zonal-office address could not be fetched. The Karnataka government sites (bescom/kptcl/kpcl .karnataka.gov.in) and grid-india.in/srldc.in all returned 503, so BESCOM (K R Circle), KPTCL (Kaveri Bhavan), KPCL (Shakti Bhavan) and SRLDC rest on named OSM objects (medium). apollohospitals.com and fortishealthcare.com returned 403, so their hospitals rest on OSM objects (medium). NOT RECORDED. BESCOM's ~30 OSM-mapped division/sub-division/O&M section offices (customer-service points, not distinct employers); KPTCL's minor OSM offices (Executive Engineer office, 'KPTCL MEI'); Apollo Hospital Jayanagar and Apollo Cradle (no reliable point/confirmation), Fortis Richmond Road (could not be geocoded); Aster Women & Children Whitefield (no address on the page fetched); Sparsh RR Nagar and Sarjapur Road (listed on Sparsh's page but neither geocoded to the right building); Narayana Nethralaya's Electronic City satellite centre; eleven further Cloudnine centres (Aurobindo Marg, Bannerghatta Road, Electronic City, HRBR Layout, Kanakapura Road, Nagarbhavi, Sahakarnagar, Sarjapur Road, Thanisandra, Varthur Road, Whitefield) whose addresses were not fetched; Rajesh Exports' Bengaluru jewellery plant (built 2001 per Wikipedia; no address found); BMRCL depots still under construction (Challaghatta, Kothanur, Shettigere, Anjanapura).
